profile.headline: Consultant Neuroradiologist · Clinical AI and Imaging Biomarkers
profile.summary: Consultant neuroradiologist and clinical researcher specialising in multiple sclerosis, neuro-oncology, X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy and presurgical functional mapping. Leads translational projects spanning imaging biomarkers, clinical AI implementation and radiology workflow redesign.
clinical_specialties: Presurgical functional MRI and diffusion tractography

appointments.title: Consultant Neuroradiologist
appointments.organization: Institut de Diagnòstic per la Imatge (IDI), Hospital Universitari de Bellvitge
details: Attending specialist in a tertiary neuroradiology service with activity in neuro-oncology, multiple sclerosis, stroke, trauma, head and neck, and spine imaging.
Clinical collaborator in the multidisciplinary functional brain mapping unit using fMRI and diffusion tractography.

projects.title: MSPredict: MS Prognosis through Advanced Imaging Analysis
projects.description: Development of a clinical decision-support tool to predict disability progression in multiple sclerosis through advanced machine learning and multimodal data integration.

projects.title: ImaginEM: AI-driven Redesign of the MRI Pathway in Multiple Sclerosis
projects.type: Clinical AI implementation and workflow transformation
projects.description: Implementation and evaluation of AI-assisted longitudinal MRI review in the Bellvitge multiple-sclerosis pathway.
outcomes: Winner of the 2026 IESE–Novartis Award, Category II (Presente digital).
Pilot evaluation included 89 paired MRI examinations and demonstrated a substantial increase in identified activity after neuroradiologist review with AI support.
projects.highlight: Pilot: 89 paired MRI examinations · IESE–Novartis award, 2026.
